notes:
Virtual hosts: Create talking character stickers with lip sync, blinking, expressions and head motion; preview and export support layered BaoCut and mesh-avatar character packages. Character creation also improves glasses, hair edges, facial expressions and small-scale sharpness.
Shorts: Cut into shorts is easier to find on Home and in AI tools. The workflow maps the full transcript before selecting qualifying topics, helping avoid missed segments.
Agent: Long documents and transcripts are paged so agents can read them completely. The agent can resume once when a task ends with unfinished acceptance checks or an unwritten translation.
Search: Local semantic search now supports Windows x64 with bundled runtime components for CPU inference.
Accounts: ElevenLabs keys without models_read permission can be saved and available voices can still be loaded.
Captions: New Classic captions use yellow text by default; existing saved styles remain unchanged and Shorts keeps its white text.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
